checked_scope: Voronoi construction, exact conditional-score bias, finite-sample risk constants and nuisance norm requirement
checks: Centers separated by >h have disjoint h/3 balls inside their indexed Voronoi cells; maximality gives radius-h coverage, diameter <=2h and lower cell mass. Lower ball mass guarantees termination and measurable finite cells.

Expanding the split-sample score gives the stated nuisance bias with both bracket signs positive; known propensity cancels it. Reciprocal-binomial and empty-bin bounds give 3M^2*N/(n+1) around cell means, then the two square inequalities give constants 6,4,4.

Final clipping reduces squared error. Holder controls cell oscillation and Jensen controls average bias; Holder inequality needs L4 nuisance factors for L2 product control, so two unsupported L2 rates cannot be multiplied.
